-- models/intermediate/stg_employee_hierarchy.sql
-- Cleans employee details and resolves management hierarchy reporting lines

WITH raw_employees AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(EmployeeId AS INT64) AS employee_id,
    CAST(ReportsTo AS INT64) AS reports_to_id,
    FirstName AS first_name,
    LastName AS last_name,
    CONCAT(FirstName, ' ', LastName) AS employee_full_name,
    Title AS job_title,
    CAST(HireDate AS DATE) AS hire_date,
    Address AS address,
    City AS city,
    State AS state,
    Country AS country,
    PostalCode AS postal_code,
    Phone AS phone,
    Fax AS fax,
    Email AS email
  FROM
    `jlhoughton-dev.chinook_raw.employees`
)

SELECT
  e.employee_id,
  e.employee_full_name,
  e.job_title,
  e.reports_to_id,
  m.employee_full_name AS manager_full_name,
  m.job_title AS manager_job_title,
  e.hire_date,
  DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), e.hire_date, YEAR) AS tenure_years,
  e.city,
  e.state,
  e.country,
  e.email
FROM raw_employees AS e
LEFT JOIN raw_employees AS m
  ON e.reports_to_id = m.employee_id

with clinics as (
    select * from `jlhoughton-dev`.`vet_saas`.`raw_clinics`
),

billing as (
    select
        clinic_id,
        date_trunc(invoice_date, month) as billing_month,
        sum(amount) as monthly_billing_amount,
        max(status) as billing_status
    from `jlhoughton-dev`.`vet_saas`.`fct_billing`
    group by 1, 2
),

scribe as (
    select
        clinic_id,
        date_trunc(event_date, month) as activity_month,
        sum(scribe_sessions) as total_scribe_sessions
    from `jlhoughton-dev`.`vet_saas`.`fct_scribe_events`
    group by 1, 2
),

monthly_aggregates as (
    select
        coalesce(s.clinic_id, b.clinic_id) as clinic_id,
        coalesce(s.activity_month, b.billing_month) as activity_month,
        coalesce(s.total_scribe_sessions, 0) as total_scribe_sessions,
        coalesce(b.monthly_billing_amount, 0) as monthly_billing_amount,
        b.billing_status
    from scribe s
    full outer join billing b 
        on s.clinic_id = b.clinic_id 
       and s.activity_month = b.billing_month
)

select
    c.clinic_id,
    c.clinic_name,
    c.tier,
    c.signup_date,
    c.mrr,
    c.dvm_seat_count,
    c.pms_connected,
    c.pms_system,
    c.is_trial_signup,
    c.trial_converted,
    a.activity_month,
    a.total_scribe_sessions,
    a.monthly_billing_amount,
    a.billing_status
from clinics c
inner join monthly_aggregates a 
    on c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id

-- models/intermediate/stg_support_workload.sql
-- Aggregates customer portfolio distribution per sales support representative

WITH raw_customers AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(CustomerId AS INT64) AS customer_id,
    CONCAT(FirstName, ' ', LastName) AS customer_full_name,
    Company AS company,
    Country AS customer_country,
    CAST(SupportRepId AS INT64) AS support_rep_id
  FROM
    `jlhoughton-dev.chinook_raw.customers`
)

SELECT
  c.support_rep_id AS employee_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS total_assigned_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_country) AS countries_covered,
  COUNTIF(c.customer_country != 'USA') AS international_customer_count
FROM raw_customers AS c
WHERE c.support_rep_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

with raw_activity as (
    select * from `jlhoughton-dev`.`vet_saas`.`int_clinic_monthly_activity`
),

-- agg clinic + monthly grain
monthly_aggregated as (
    select
        clinic_id,
        clinic_name,
        tier,
        signup_date,
        dvm_seat_count,
        pms_connected,
        pms_system,
        is_trial_signup,
        trial_converted,
        activity_month,
        
        -- map intermediate metrics to performance names
        coalesce(monthly_billing_amount, 0) as total_billed,
        coalesce(total_scribe_sessions, 0) as total_scribe_events
        
    from raw_activity
),

calculated_metrics as (
    select
clinic_id,
        clinic_name,
        tier,
        signup_date,
        dvm_seat_count,
        pms_connected,
        pms_system,
        is_trial_signup,
        trial_converted,
        activity_month,
        total_billed as mrr,
        total_scribe_events,
        
        -- engagement tier based on scribe activity
        case 
            when total_scribe_events = 0 then 'Zero Activity'
            when total_scribe_events < 10 then 'Low Usage'
            when total_scribe_events between 10 and 50 then 'Moderate Usage'
            else 'Power User'
        end as engagement_tier,

        -- active account status
        case 
            when total_billed > 0 or total_scribe_events > 0 then true 
            else false 
        end as is_active,

        -- MoM compare
        lag(total_billed) over (
            partition by clinic_id 
            order by activity_month
        ) as prev_month_mrr,

        lag(total_scribe_events) over (
            partition by clinic_id 
            order by activity_month
        ) as prev_month_scribe_events

    from monthly_aggregated
)

select
    *,
    -- rev vari
    mrr - coalesce(prev_month_mrr, 0) as mrr_change,
    
    -- risk/churn indicator
    case 
        when prev_month_mrr > 0 and mrr = 0 then 'Churned'
        when prev_month_mrr > 0 and mrr < prev_month_mrr then 'At Risk (Contract Downgrade)'
        when prev_month_mrr = 0 or prev_month_mrr is null then 'New / Reactivated'
        else 'Stable / Growing'
    end as clinic_health_status

from calculated_metrics
where activity_month is not null

-- models/domain/dim_support_capacity_performance.sql
-- Consolidates employee hierarchy, account workloads, and revenue performance for Looker Studio

WITH employee_base AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(employee_id AS INT64) AS employee_id,
    employee_full_name,
    job_title,
    manager_full_name,
    tenure_years
  FROM `jlhoughton-dev.chinook_raw.stg_employee_hierarchy`
),

workload_base AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(employee_id AS INT64) AS employee_id,
    total_assigned_customers,
    countries_covered
  FROM `jlhoughton-dev.chinook_raw.stg_support_workload`
),

revenue_base AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(c.SupportRepId AS INT64) AS employee_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.InvoiceId) AS total_orders_handled,
    ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total_portfolio_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(i.Total), 2) AS average_order_value
  FROM `jlhoughton-dev.chinook_raw.invoices` AS i
  JOIN `jlhoughton-dev.chinook_raw.customers` AS c
    ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT
  emp.employee_id,
  emp.employee_full_name,
  emp.job_title,
  emp.manager_full_name,
  emp.tenure_years,
  COALESCE(work.total_assigned_customers, 0) AS total_assigned_customers,
  COALESCE(work.countries_covered, 0) AS countries_covered,
  COALESCE(rev.total_orders_handled, 0) AS total_orders_handled,
  COALESCE(rev.total_portfolio_revenue, 0.0) AS total_portfolio_revenue,
  COALESCE(rev.average_order_value, 0.0) AS average_order_value,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(rev.total_portfolio_revenue, work.total_assigned_customers) AS revenue_per_account
FROM employee_base AS emp
LEFT JOIN workload_base AS work
  ON emp.employee_id = work.employee_id
LEFT JOIN revenue_base AS rev
  ON emp.employee_id = rev.employee_id
WHERE emp.job_title LIKE '%Sales%Support%'
